title: So much easier to use these than to clean the crock.
text:
So much easier to use these than to clean the crock.. Love this! I love these liners! So much easier to clean up the crock. Just pull out the bag and toss! In most cases there are no leaks so the crock pots just needs to be wiped down, the crock itself is clean.

So much easier. I have one crockpot in which the crock can't be removed, this is great. It's kind of small for the bags, but I can still use them.

These are a must if you use a crock pot.

description: Make memorable meals with Reynolds Kitchens Slow Cooker Liners, and save time on cleanup. Grab these slow cooker bags for slow cooking without dealing with stubborn, stuck-on messes. Simply lift the slow cooker liner when the cooking is done and your slow cooker is clean in less than eight seconds—guaranteed! Each slow cooker bag measures 13 x 21 inches to fit 1- to 3-quart round and oval slow cookers, and is made with a BPA-free heat resistant (up to 400 degrees Fahrenheit) nylon-blend construction. Spend more time with your loved ones and less time in the kitchen with these FDA-compliant, food-safe Reynolds Kitchens Slow Cooker Liners.
